result.description: Fires on the 'ay' piece in "Faraday" when the word is split as "ad"+"ay" (e.g. "adays law"), before 's. It stays silent when 'ay' follows other pieces such as "Farad" or "Farawad".
result.label: 'ay' in split Faraday

result.description: Fires on ' make' when it is the first piece of the compound "makeup", especially "genetic makeup". It stays silent on ' make' as a plain verb ("must make wise"). Logits favour the continuation 'up'.
result.label: ' make' in "makeup"

result.description: Fires on a sentence-ending period (occasionally a colon) in cooking and culinary text, especially where a sentence about flavor, tenderness or technique ends and a new item or section follows. It stays quiet on periods in other topics.
result.label: Sentence-end period in culinary text

result.description: Fires mostly on "BI" in the acronym "(BI)" right after "Business Intelligence" is spelled out. It fires only weakly on a few other tokens, such as " unique" in a linear-algebra context.
result.label: BI acronym after Business Intelligence

result.description: Fires on the last word of "social protection/welfare/safety/security" (' protection', 'are' in welfare, ' safety', ' security') in social-policy text. It predicts policy-program nouns next, such as schemes, measures, programs and policies.
result.label: Social protection/welfare policy noun

result.description: Fires on ' both' after a linking verb like "can be", "is", "are", "has been", introducing a pair of predicates ("can be both X and Y"). Silent on ' both' as a determiner in "both sides".
result.label: 'both' after linking verb

result.description: Fires on ' rather' in the "X rather than Y" construction, where it is expected to be followed by "than". It stays silent on "but rather" with no following "than". It pushes the next token towards ' than'.
result.label: "rather" in "rather than"

result.description: Fires on word-initial pieces ' Pale', ' Mes', ' Ne' that begin era or period names (Paleolithic, Mesozoic, Neolithic, Mesopotamia), mainly in history or prehistory text. It pushes toward continuations like 'ol', 'oz', 'o'.
result.label: Pale-/Mes-/Ne- era name prefixes

result.description: Fires mostly on the suffix 'ic' in "therapeut-ic" in music-therapy text, sometimes on 'its' after "utilize". Silent on the same 'ic' in other contexts (melodic, nostalgic). Members are music/therapy topic detectors.
result.label: therapeutic 'ic' in music therapy

result.description: Fires on the second ' as' of an equative comparison ("as important to X as it is to Y"), after an adjective and its complement. It stays silent on ' as' meaning "serve as", "because", or "in the role of".
result.label: Second 'as' in 'as ADJ as'

result.description: Fires on the word-start prefixes " multi" and " tri" (multi-tier, multiuser, trials, triangles), where a continuation like -ples, -player, -angles or -als is expected. Members are mostly multi/tri prefix detectors.
result.label: multi- / tri- prefix pieces

result.description: Fires on word pieces like " pro" (proton), " p" (pH), "dis" and " acid" in acid-base chemistry text, predicting acid/base terms next. Silent on "proton" in physics or biochemistry contexts, so it needs acid-base chemistry.
result.label: Acid-base chemistry word pieces

result.description: Fires on the possessive 's after a scientist's surname (Ampère's, Gauss's, Euler's) in physics or maths text, where a named law or theorem comes next. It stays quiet on 's after common nouns like theory or gravity.
result.label: Possessive 's after scientist surname

result.description: Fires on the piece 'iv' inside "pivotal" (p|iv|otal), predicting the continuation "otal". It stays silent on 'iv' in other words like "captivating".
result.label: 'iv' in "pivotal"

result.description: Fires on the word " health" as a standalone word, most strongly in "financial health" of a company. It stays silent when "health" is a piece inside "healthcare". Weak activity on finance words like "supply".
result.label: financial " health"

result.description: Fires on the verb " serves" (also " serve") after a subject noun, in the "X serves as ..." function/role construction. Members detect serve/act/function verbs. The contrast text has no such verb and stays silent.
result.label: "serves" as role verb

result.description: Fires on ' English' (rarely French/Spanish) when it follows a preposition or modifier as the language name, e.g. "in English" or "Old English". Silent when ' English' starts a sentence or follows "many".
result.label: ' English' after "in" / modifier

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' diplom' (also 'plom' in e-diplomacy) as the start of diplomacy/diplomatic/diplomat, predicting the suffix that completes the word. Members are mostly diplom detectors plus similar word-stem detectors.
result.label: diplom- word stem

result.description: Fires on the token ' data' as the object or head noun after a verb or modifier (analyze, raw, sensory, training data). It stays silent in 'big data' and in 'data-driven' compounds. It weakly pushes towards follow-on nouns like patterns and inputs.
result.label: ' data' as head noun, not 'big data'

result.description: Fires on the word "festival" (also Festival, festiv-, occasionally "event") as a noun, often after "Music" or as a modifier in festival-related text. Members are mostly festival-token detectors; it pushes toward words like grounds, hosting and occasions.
result.label: festival word detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Gen" / " gen" when it begins a word like Genetic, genetics, genes, genres. It predicts continuations such as 'etic', 'ome' and 'omic'. It stays quiet on the complete word "gene".
result.label: Gen- word-start piece (genetic)

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ic' (also ' mechanical', ' mechan') of 'mechanic(s)' when it follows 'quantum mechan'. Silent on 'ic' in other words like organic or lattice. Pushes towards nouns like principles, properties, effects.
result.label: quantum mechan-ic ending

result.description: Fires on " through" meaning "by means of", after an abstract outcome noun or verb phrase (growth through, diversity through), in business or corporate prose. Quiet after "collected through" (a data source). Predicts positive, method-type words next.
result.label: "through" as means after outcome noun
emer-ged verb ending
result.description: Fires on the ending piece 'ged'/'ges'/'ge' of "emerge" (emerged, emerges) after a subject noun, as in "X emerged as/in/from". Predicts " as" or "from" next. Members are detectors of emer- + ge pieces.

Fires on the word "space" (or "Space") in aerospace and spacecraft engineering text, as in "space missions" or "Spacecraft Systems" headings. It predicts continuations like "craft", "flight" and "missions".
result.label: ' space' in spacecraft text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'om' in the middle of a longer word (bi-om-ass, bi-om-es, clin-om-eters, Nan-om-aterials), where more word pieces are expected to follow. Silent when 'om' starts the text or follows other pieces.
result.label: 'om' mid-word piece

result.description: Fires on time-span nouns like " period", " years", " time", "decades" right after "the" in phrases like "In the period of..." or "During the years...". Silent when the word starts a sentence or follows "a" as a predicate noun.
result.label: Time-span noun after "the"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'unn' in "tunneling" (t-unn-eling), mostly in quantum tunneling contexts. It predicts continuations like 'eling', 'elling' and 'els'. It fires weakly on 'unn' in other words such as "forerunners" and "funnels".
result.label: 'unn' in tunneling

result.description: Fires mostly on ' teach' (as in Buddhist "teachings") in religious or philosophical text about Buddhism and spiritual practice, plus scattered other tokens in that setting. Members include teach-detectors and Buddhism/spirituality topic latents.
result.label: Teach- in Buddhist/spiritual text
